name: Memory Manager
author: Brett
description: Memory Manager: every place Claude memory lives in AmberX-AXF (CLAUDE.md and its rules, THREADS.md, STATUS.md, decisions, memory docs, the chunked store, session logs, build reports, the hub copy, ~/.claude) in one list, with what reads and what writes each file (the audit map plus a code scan you can refresh). Full management: view, edit, move, delete, version history with restore, search inside every file, filter by category, kind, root, writer and loaded-at-start, rebuild the chunks, and see what a session loads at start. Includes its own copy of MD Studio's Markdown editor (dock tabs, split, preview, conflict-safe saves) so MD Studio can be removed later.

items.title: List Markdown files
items.description: Every .md file by scope (Project, Claude, Repo, Notes) and category. q filters by name or path; content=true also searches inside the files.

items.title: Read a Markdown file
items.description: One file by id (repo:<path>, hub:<project>/<path>, notes:<folder>/<name>.md): its text, version, token count and references.

items.title: Save a Markdown file
items.description: Write a file: {id, content, if_version}. if_version "" creates only; the version from read-file saves only if nobody changed it since. The replaced text is kept in the version history.

items.title: Read a kept version of a file
Context chain with token counts
items.description: A file and everything it references (imports, links, paths) as a tree, with about how many tokens each part costs and the total.

items.title: Open a file in Memory Manager
items.description: Opens a Markdown file as a tab in the open console (args: an id or a path such as CLAUDE.md, notes/plans/x.md).

items.title: Open a file to edit in Memory Manager
Open the context view of a file in Memory Manager
List memory files
items.description: Every Claude memory file with its location, category, kind, whether it loads at start, and what reads and writes it. Filters: q, category, kind (memory|builds|log|generated), root (repo|hub|user), writer, loaded=true.

items.title: Refresh the memory scan
items.description: Scan the code again for readers and writers of memory files, then list every memory file.

items.title: Memory file details
items.description: One memory file's location, readers and writers (id = repo:<path> or hub:<project>/<path>).

items.title: Search inside memory files
items.description: Every memory file whose text has all the words, with hit counts and a snippet.

items.title: Move or rename a memory file
items.description: {id, to, if_version}: within its scope; the old text is kept in the version history.

items.title: Delete a memory file
items.description: {id, if_version}: the text is kept as a version, so restore brings it back.

items.title: List memory chunks
items.description: The chunked store's index (_claude/chunks): id, source, title, tokens, date; q and source filter.

items.title: Rebuild the memory chunks
items.description: Regenerate _claude/chunks from CLAUDE.md, THREADS, STATUS, decisions and the memory docs.

items.title: What a session loads at start
items.description: Builds started in the last N hours (hours, default 24) that stopped unfinished, and the chunk index.

items.title: Memory audit
items.description: Every place memory lives and every part of the app that reads or writes it (memory-map@1).

items.title: Memory Manager settings
items.description: Settings by category (Scan, List, Safety, Chunks) with defaults and choices.
